newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Essef Corp upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Essef Corp upgraded to buy.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Tuesday it upgraded water treatment equipment maker Essef Corp to buy from hold. Essef said Monday it plans to acquire swimming pool firm General Aquatics Inc.

- Analyst Saul Ludwig said in a report he will not adjust his earnings estimates until Essef says whether it plans to sell equity to repay debt it will take on in the $68 million acquisition and until more detail is available on General Aquatics' potential operating margins.
- But, he said, potential benefits outweigh risks. Until more detail is available, he kept earnings estimates of $1.50 a share in 1997 and $1.65 in 1998 versus $1.42 in 1996.
